title: Evaluating Agentic Learning Harness Capabilities Without Labels via the Scaling Hypothesis
abstract: arXiv:2608.13608v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agentic "Continual Learning Harnesses", systems that pair an LLM with retrieval or memory to improve from feedback without retraining, have shown growing value in cybersecurity. But their value is conventionally measured by gains against labeled benchmarks, an approach that often fails in operational security settings. Benchmark labels are scarce, stale, and unrepresentative, so a practitioner often cannot tell whether a given harness helps at all or which of two is better for their task. Traditional LLM-as-a-judge offers little signal because it is no stronger than the agent it evaluates, and distillation is unreliable on scarce, sporadic, and biased labels.   We propose a framework for evaluating learning harnesses end-to-end without a labeled benchmark, grounded in the scaling hypothesis. translated_title: 基于缩放假设的无标签评估代理学习驾驭能力
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13608v1 公告类型：新 摘要：代理型“持续学习驾驭系统”，即通过检索或记忆将LLM配对，以无需重新训练即可从反馈中改进的系统，在网络安全领域显示出日益增长的价值。但其价值通常通过对比带标签基准的增益来衡量，这种方法在运营安全场景中往往失效。基准标签稀缺、过时且不具代表性，因此实践者常常无法判断某个驾驭系统是否有效，或两个系统中哪个更适合其任务。传统LLM作为评判者提供的信号有限，因为它不比被评估的代理更强，且蒸馏在标签稀少、零散和有偏见的情况下不可靠。我们提出一个基于缩放假设的框架，无需带标签基准即可端到端评估学习驾驭系统。一个更强的教师模型向带有持续学习驾驭系统的较小学生模型提供稀疏采样的纠正。我们通过驾驭系统在多大程度上提升学生模型性能来评分。
tldr: 提出了一种基于缩放假设的无标签评估框架，利用更强教师模型的稀疏纠正来衡量持续学习驾驭系统的端到端改进效果，解决了网络安全中基准标签稀缺导致评估困难的问题。
en_tdlr: We propose a scaling-hypothesis-based framework for label-free end-to-end evaluation of continual learning harnesses, using sparse corrections from a stronger teacher to measure how much the harness improves a smaller student model, addressing the challenge of scarce benchmark labels in cybersecurity.
